confirmedIssues: Blocked: src/context-steward/pi/pi-extension.ts:563-617 still auto-opens/creates a managed thread for session_start, session_before_switch, session_shutdown, turn_start, turn_end, and message_end. That breaks Epic AC-5.1/AC-5.6 for pre-existing unmanaged sessions: I reproduced a pre-populated session where session_start created a thread containing only a runtime_event, and the next /lh-attach failed with TARGET_ASSOCIATION_CONFLICT instead of importing prior history.

Blocked: /lh-attach still ignores live active-branch context and can bind imported history to the wrong target. executeAttachCommand() only forwards the current context target plus sessionFilePath (src/context-steward/pi/pi-extension.ts:304-320), and attachExistingPiSession() prefers the context target session id/path when creating the thread (src/context-steward/services/import-service.ts:276-310). I reproduced both failures: a branched session returned IMPORT_PATH_AMBIGUOUS through /lh-attach while the fixture flow imported the active branch, and /lh-attach <other-session-file> created a thread targeted at the current live session while recording import.sourceSessionId from the live session instead of the imported file.

Blocked: the epic gate is still hollow. The test plan requires verify-all integration smoke coverage via file-thread-store.integration.test.ts (docs/spec-build/epics/01-session-context-store/test-plan.md:221-235), but there are no *.integration.test.ts files under tests/, and scripts/run-node-tests.mjs:39-43 exits 0 when discovery is empty. I ran npm run verify-all; it succeeded only after printing "No integration tests found."

Confirmed coverage gap: the planned command-surface tests for /lh-attach, /lh-turn-health, and /lh-repair-turns are still missing. The test plan expects them (docs/spec-build/epics/01-session-context-store/test-plan.md:181-185), but tests/context-steward/pi-extension-commands.test.ts:88-220 only covers formatter behavior, /lh-fixture, and /lh-status.
disputedOrUnconfirmedIssues: The fabricated import-time sessionManager shim in src/context-steward/services/import-service.ts remains in place, but I did not independently confirm a current acceptance-criteria failure caused by that shim beyond the attach/import bugs above.
result.readinessAssessment: npm run verify passed with 104 unit tests, but the epic is not ready for closeout. The production attach/import path still violates the AC-5 attach/import contract, and npm run verify-all is not a meaningful release gate because the required integration layer is absent and treated as success.
result.recommendedNextStep: Fix the production attach/import path first: stop auto-managing pre-populated or newly switched unmanaged sessions before attach/import, pass the live activeLeafId/sessionManager through /lh-attach, ensure the imported session/path becomes the new thread target and import source metadata, then add the planned command and integration tests so verify-all fails unless those production paths actually run.
